summary.name: Canva
summary.one_liner: Canva is an online graphic design tool for making social media posts, presentations, posters, videos, logos and printed materials, with AI-powered editing features.
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Canva as a browser-based design suite for social posts, presentations, videos, posters, logos and prints. It lists AI features including Magic Layers (turning an image into an editable layout), Magic Eraser, one-click background removal, Magic Write for text, and Image Upscaler. Presentation tools include a Brand Kit, templates and animations. Video tools include a video editor, templates, stock videos and AI-powered captions. A Print Shop section covers resizing designs for print and creating invitations and images for prints.
notable: Magic Layers turns a flat image into an editable layout
Built-in Print Shop for ordering printed designs
Brand Kit for keeping designs on-brand
AI tools for writing, photo cleanup, and captions
caveats: Page does not state which features require a paid plan
Free use is described in the meta description, but the page text itself gives no pricing details
